result.changelog:
All 7 entries were cut to 386-399 words (drafts ran 421-504).
Crateria/Brinstar: the manga Skree scene now matches Metroid Wiki (Kreatz spots it, and it then kills a Pirate). Ripper and Reo details are labelled "per the manual". Added the three Tourian Sidehoppers (Super Missiles only; the baby Metroid kills the last) and the note that "Zoomer" was a mistranslation of Geemer. The report called the "sticky liquid, per the manual" line unverified. It is kept because Metroid Wiki's Zoomer page quotes it from the manuals.
Norfair: Geruta colours softened. Gamet detail labelled "per the manual". Only the Fune is called eyeless. Added the lava flooding and the baby Metroid's broken capsule in Ridley's lair.
Maridia: dropped "ancient flood" and "beneath Brinstar". Added the Gravity Suit requirement, the Power Bomb tunnel and the Space Jump/Plasma Beam/Spring Ball. Zoa wording softened. "Breeding" changed to "cloning", with the Mochtroid manual line Metroid Wiki actually cites.
SR388: the made-up "first creature taken over by X" claim is replaced with the manga quote. Metroid Wiki says Old Bird spoke to other Chozo, not to young Samus as the report suggested. Removed the five Samus Returns-only behaviours. Fixed Yumbo, Gravitt and Shirk. Added that the Chozo created the Metroids to fight the X, plus the Hornoad scene with Proteus Ridley's arm.
ZDR: removed Dropter, Caterzilla, Daivo, Slidle and Blindfly as unconfirmed. Kept Sabotoru, which a search confirmed. The robots' Chozo origin is now "believed", as Nintendo words it. Added that Golzuna is a mutated Muzby and Escue a mutated Quetzoa.
Bottle Ship: Desbrachians move at high speed rather than teleport; they were disguised as door alarms and MB woke them to kill Federation soldiers. Removed the Little Birdie/Dragotix link and the Mighty Griptian Screw Attack claim. Groganch weak spot corrected to an orange bulb; Himella fires ice shards. Added the Gigafraug Metroid-predation corpse and the Rhedogian elevator fight after seven Super Zebesians.
BSL: Zero-X/Zoro naming, Memu's wall-passing removed, and Adam's "evolving, resisting your weapons" remark added.
Keys: dropped risky bare words (Ripper, Waver, Zeb, Nova, Holtz, Moto, Needler, Mumbo, Zoro, Geron, Moto-X, Atomics, Work Robot, Blindflyer). Added Ripper II, Autom, Zero-X and Emperor Brug.
result.unresolved: Every entry still has 21-46 keys, well over the 3-12 rule, because the domain brief asks for every creature name and its plural; this needs a decision. "Zoomer" is kept even though it is also slang. Some descriptions rest only on search snippets quoting Wikitroid or on one player guide: Kyratian, Ghalmanian, Dragotix, Fumbleye, Joulion, Volfon (packs of three), Groganch, Himella and Sabotoru. Metroid Wiki has no pages for these. Geruboss, Gelon and Genesis are fan-database spellings Metroid Wiki does not cover. The claim that Samus caught the X by shooting a Hornoad was not re-checked against a source. selective_logic is AND_ANY with empty secondary_keys, so the entries fire on keys alone.
